Act Math by High School GPA

2025-10-16

PURPOSE: This contains some visualizations describing math courses by first time freshmen. I may turn this into a “child” document.

Filters

The first term that a first time freshman took a math course was determined. Then, all math courses in that term were extracted.

Next, the following filters are applied:

  • High school GPA values of zero are removed.
  • Rare, missing, and withdraw grades (“missing”, “V”, “I”, “NC”, “CR”, “W”, NA) are removed.
  • Students with more than the 99th percentile in course load (19 credits) are removed.
  • Math courses taken before half a year before the cohort date (yr_diff < 0.5) are removed. This allows for taking math classes the summer before the fall cohort date.
  • Students with ages less than 12 are removed.
  • All courses greater than 3000 are removed.
  • Classes that were not offered after 2021 are removed.
